title: Three Nights and One Short Lens
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：rating　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 rating 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the observer ① gave the rating that no assistant in the observatory would have recorded, and he said the giving was the whole of the night. The ② rating, meaning the score itself and not the lens, ran three nights and stayed unrecorded in the book; a rating, he said, is the only thing in an observatory that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ rating in that observatory had the same short lens beside it, and the ④ rating at the far dome, meaning the reading they kept for the children to note and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A rating, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the observer said the recording is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the rating was the whole of the matter, meaning the judgement and not the score. The ⑥ rating, meaning the judgement and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; rating, he said, is either something you give or the only word that means both a score and a judgement. He said the judgement is the part they remember.

By 1986 the ⑦ rating had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short lens. The ⑧ rating of the whole thing, the observer wrote in November, was one observatory and three nights of recording; rating, he said, is either the reading at the far dome or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ rating I remember is the score recorded in the log, which closed in 1988 and is still recorded as the quietest in the observatory. A ⑩ rating, my mother said in 1990, is the only score that improves by being recorded; every rating, she said, is a judgement that has agreed to look like a score. She said the judgement was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 等级；评分（指观测站里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 等级；评分（指那个等级本身，与小小的镜片相对）
C. 固定搭配：give the rating 打出这一个等级
D. n. 等级；评分（指留给孩子们记的那一组）
E. n. 等级之事（抽象总称，指一处观测站的等级之事）
F. n. 等级；评分（指观测记录里写到、被记载的那一个）
G. n. 等级、评判（指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 评判（抽象总称，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: gave the rating that no assistant in the observatory would have recorded
The rating, meaning the score itself and not the lens
the rating at the far dome
the rating was the whole of the matter
the rating had become a line in a log
The rating of the whole thing
A rating, my mother said in 1990

answers.why: give the rating 意为“打出这一个等级”，1981 年那位观测员把观测站里没有一位助手肯记载的一个等级做了一遍。
rating 意为“等级；评分”，指那个等级本身而不是小小的镜片，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记载。
rating 意为“等级；评分”，指观测站里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一片小小的镜片。
rating 意为“等级；评分”，指最远那座圆顶的留给孩子们记的那一组，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
rating 意为“等级、评判”，指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个评判就是那件事的全部。
rating 意为“评判”，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个等级，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
rating 意为“等级；评分”，指观测记录里写到、被记载的那一个，到 1986 年这一个成了观测记录里的一行。
rating 意为“等级之事”，观测员十一月写道，整件事的等级之事是一处观测站和三个夜晚的记载。
rating 意为“等级；评分”，我记得的是观测记录里记载过的那一个，1988 年记下了，至今仍被说成观测站里最安静的一个。
rating 为抽象总称，母亲 1990 年说，等级是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的等级。
